summary: Mingteng International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a private placement of 3,800,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.25 per share for total proceeds of US$950,000, with participation by CEO Yingkai Xu who purchased 1,520,000 shares. The board approved the transaction, deeming terms fair to shareholders. The offering was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. This sale of stock for cash represents a capital raising event rather than a special situation like a tender or restructuring. Watch for dilution impact on existing shareholders and future filings regarding use of proceeds.
